props.h1Text: Imported vs. Indian Equipment: What's Better for Your Budget?

items.summaryText: Q1: Is Indian playground equipment safe for children?
items.pText: Yes, many Indian brands now follow international safety standards and use child-safe materials.

items.summaryText: Q2: Can I get spare parts easily for Indian equipment?
items.pText: Yes, since Indian equipment is made locally, spare parts and service are usually quick and affordable.

items.summaryText: Q3: When should I consider imported playground equipment?
items.pText: Imported equipment is a good choice if you need highly specialized designs, luxury features, or have a large budget for premium products.
